function.name: calculate_mortgage_payment
function.description: Calculate the monthly mortgage payment given the loan amount, annual interest rate, and number of years. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

loan_amount.description: The loan amount. This is a float type value.

annual_rate.description: The annual interest rate in percentage. This is a float type value.

years.description: Number of years the mortgage is amortized over.

message.content:
I’m not able to pull in live market data, so I can’t give you an exact “current” rate at this moment.  
If you’re looking for a rough idea:

| Type | Typical range (as of early 2026) |
|------|----------------------------------|
| 30‑year fixed‑rate mortgage | ~5.0 % – 6.5 % |
| 15‑year fixed‑rate mortgage | ~4.0 % – 5.5 % |
| 5/1 ARM (first 5 years fixed) | ~4.5 % – 6.0 % |
| Short‑term (≤5 yr) fixed | ~3.5 % – 5.0 % |

These ranges can vary by lender, credit score, down‑payment size, and region. If you need the precise rate you’d get today, let me know which loan type and any specific details (credit score, down‑payment, etc.) and I can help you estimate what to expect—or guide you on how to check with your bank or a mortgage broker.
